Ava (CS): Quick heads-up 12 trial tenants saw delayed activations this morning. Need a short, personal note + credit + priority enablement. Draft below.

Diego (Support): Which steps failed?

Ava (CS): Webhook retries and final reindex stalled between 09:07		09:42 UTC. No data exposure. Link to list: https://redwood.internal/cs/impacted-trials

IncidentBot: INCIDENT-2026-0426 created - onboard throttles. Assigned eng-runtime.

Priya (CS Manager): Draft outbound (short):

"Hi [Name],\n\nWere sorry  a routing change this morning temporarily throttled onboarding jobs and slowed activation. We reverted the change at 09:42 UTC and cleared the backlog.\n\nOffer: 30m onboarding assist + one-time credit (10% prorated). No data was exposed.\n\nReply to book a session. Feedback: https://redwood.internal/cs/feedback" 

Marta (Solutions Eng): Add one-line RCA for enterprise notes: regression in autoscaler routing to cost-optimized pool without saturation checks; rollback + saturation guard deployed.

Liam (Sales Ops): Ill prepare credit memos. For accounts flagged as renewal-risk, approved 15% instead of 10%.

Ava (CS): Plan: send enterprise at 11:00 UTC with AM cc and calendar stub; SMB at 12:30 UTC. Diego please send enterprise first.

Diego (Support): Enterprise batch sent at 11:02 UTC. CCs included. :white_check_mark:

Priya (CS Manager): A few enterprise replies requesting immediate assists. Scheduling now.

Diego (Support): SMB batch sent at 11:20 UTC. No major replies yet.

Ava (CS): Closing: capture responses in account health tracker, flag renewal-risk changes, attach engineering postmortem when available. Thanks everyone.
